advancements.ftboss.root.title: §6Farming Tales §7· §fBoss Compendium
advancements.ftboss.root.description: Ten champions, each holding their own ground — go and knock on every door
advancements.ftboss.boss_sugar_queen.spo: The whole manor falls still — even the wind, it turns out, tastes of sugar
advancements.ftboss.boss_sugar_queen.sla: The crown lies shattered; the sugar falls no more
advancements.ftboss.boss_meat_mountain.s: The block catches the light, and the cleaver falls — once, and again
The cleaver halts mid-air; the board is quiet at last
advancements.ftboss.boss_tea_tree.spotte: A wisp of fresh tea rises in the garden, and the leaves begin to murmur
The last breath of steam is gone; the branches bow, and say no more
advancements.ftboss.boss_wine_barrel.spo: A muffled thunder rolls up from below — oak grinding over stone
advancements.ftboss.boss_wine_barrel.sla: The wine runs dry; an empty barrel spins where it stood
advancements.ftboss.boss_rat_boss.spotte: First a rustle in the wall — then the whole floor begins to move
The last one slips into the dark; the granary holds
advancements.ftboss.boss_defect_core.spo: An overloaded hum drowns out the rain; sparks light up, one after another
advancements.ftboss.boss_defect_core.sla: The hum cuts out — only ozone, and code no one can read
A long howl splits the pasture, and the herd falls into line
advancements.ftboss.boss_benger.slain.de: The howl dies away; at last it steps aside
The sea arches into a blue-green shadow — the banquet has begun
The tide draws back and the surface closes, as if nothing had happened
advancements.ftboss.boss_slayer_all.desc: Five lords of the table, every blade laid down — half the road is behind you
advancements.ftboss.blood_pact.title: §cSanguine Bond
advancements.ftboss.blood_pact.descripti: Take it in hand — its crimson surface seems to thirst for blood
advancements.ftboss.boss_apple_boss.spot: The air turns cloyingly sweet; something in the shadows bows to you
advancements.ftboss.boss_apple_boss.slai: Honeycrisp falls; the sweetness clears, leaving only rust
advancements.ftboss.boss_compost_boss.sp: The air turns rich and thick — a figure descends from above
advancements.ftboss.boss_compost_boss.sl: The rainbow touches down; that one was worth the smell

guide.ftboss.bonds.pack.effect: An eligible melee, arrow, staff-spell or trident hit on a hostile mob summons up to two friendly wolves for 30 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds; an existing pack blocks a new one.
guide.ftboss.bonds.pack.note: Switching weapons, logout or dimension travel dismisses wolves. No attacks on players/pets, no loot or XP. Manor non-player damage rules still apply.
guide.ftboss.bonds.pack.requirement: On one weapon: at least 2 meat-category foods and 1 cheese-category food in food accessory sockets.
guide.ftboss.bonds.pack.title: Feast pack
guide.ftboss.bonds.resonance.effect: Raises the matching three-piece set by one tier, up to IV. 3 fish + 1 wine also unlocks Tidal wine wings.
guide.ftboss.bonds.resonance.note: Partners: tea↔apple, meat↔cheese, fish↔wine, vegetable↔energy; sweet/general food + apple. Base socket power already uses ×1.5; resonance does not add 50% total damage.
guide.ftboss.bonds.resonance.requirement: At least 3 matching foods plus 1 partner food. Example: 3 tea + 1 apple, or 3 apple + 1 tea.
guide.ftboss.bonds.resonance.title: Flavor resonance
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_apple.effect: An apple-affinity weapon grants Regeneration I/II/III while held in the main hand.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_apple.note: Requires apple weapon affinity. Partner: tea. Set tier is the rounded-down average of the best 3 matching offerings. Resonance adds one tier, up to IV.

guide.ftboss.bonds.set_apple.title: Apple three-piece set
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_cheese.effect: A cheese-affinity weapon inflicts Weakness I/II/III for 4 seconds on hit.

guide.ftboss.bonds.set_cheese.title: Cheese three-piece set
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_energy.effect: Hits trigger 4/6/8 chain magic damage; cooldown: 2 seconds.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_energy.note: Partner: vegetable. Set tier is the rounded-down average of the best 3 matching offerings. Resonance adds one tier, up to IV.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_energy.requiremen: Install at least 3 energy-category offerings in the same weapon’s food accessory sockets.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_energy.title: Energy three-piece set

guide.ftboss.bonds.set_fish.note: Hold the weapon in the main hand in the required environment. Partner: wine. Set tier is the rounded-down average of the best 3 matching offerings. Resonance adds one tier, up to IV.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_fish.requirement: Install at least 3 fish-category offerings in the same weapon’s food accessory sockets.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_fish.title: Fish three-piece set

guide.ftboss.bonds.set_meat.requirement: Install at least 3 meat-category offerings in the same weapon’s food accessory sockets.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_meat.title: Meat three-piece set
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_sweet.effect: Hits grant Absorption I/II/III for 4 seconds; cooldown: 5 seconds.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_sweet.note: Sweet and general food share a count and may be mixed. Partner: apple. Set tier is the rounded-down average of the best 3 matching offerings. Resonance adds one tier, up to IV.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_sweet.requirement: Install at least 3 sweet / general food-category offerings in the same weapon’s food accessory sockets.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_sweet.title: Sweet / general food three-piece set

guide.ftboss.bonds.set_tea.requirement: Install at least 3 tea-category offerings in the same weapon’s food accessory sockets.
guide.ftboss.bonds.set_tea.title: Tea three-piece set

guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_bow.note: Arrow hits use the firing weapon context; changing weapons may invalidate later bond triggers. Food quality affects set level, not required counts.

guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_crossbow.effec: Unlock Tidal Flight, Feast Pack, Flavor Resonance, nine food sets, Price Guard, Series Echo, Color Repel and Process Burst. Exact recipes and counts are listed in their category pages.
guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_crossbow.note: Crossbows use the ranged-hit path. Eligible crossbow projectiles can satisfy hit conditions; melee swings are not required.

guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_staff.effect: Unlock Tidal Flight, Feast Pack, Flavor Resonance, nine food sets, Price Guard, Series Echo, Color Repel and Process Burst. Exact recipes and counts are listed in their category pages.
guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_staff.note: Spell hits must be attributed to this staff. Merely holding it does not turn unrelated spell damage into staff hits.

guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_axe.effect: Unlock Tidal Flight, Feast Pack, Flavor Resonance, nine food sets, Price Guard, Series Echo, Color Repel and Process Burst. Exact recipes and counts are listed in their category pages.
guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_axe.note: Axes use melee hits for hit-triggered bonds. Offhand or inventory presence alone does not satisfy a hit requirement.

guide.ftboss.bonds.weapon_trident.note: Melee and thrown hits use their respective paths. A thrown projectile must be attributable to the trident that launched it.
guide.ftboss.bonds.fed_grip.title: Fed Grip: iron-sword material bond
guide.ftboss.bonds.fed_grip.requirement: Iron sword only: at least two paid metal pieces plus one paid food piece in the material structure. The food needs nutrition ≥4 and actual saturation gain ≥1.
guide.ftboss.bonds.fed_grip.effect: Wear coefficient −3% while the structure is usable and the full recipe is satisfied.
guide.ftboss.bonds.fed_grip.note: Iron sword only: this food must also occupy an accessory slot (structure cell) as a material piece. Food in separate food accessory sockets and native references do not count. This exclusive recipe does not apply to other weapons.
guide.ftboss.bonds.price_guard.title: Price Guard
guide.ftboss.bonds.price_guard.requireme: In one weapon’s food accessory sockets, use either three distinct foods priced ≤10, or distinct foods covering at least three price bands: ≤10, (10,30], (30,80], and >80.
guide.ftboss.bonds.price_guard.effect: Taking a qualifying hit triggers a guard lasting 4 seconds: 3 absorption points for the low-price recipe, or 4 for three-band diversity. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
guide.ftboss.bonds.price_guard.note: Uses catalog base prices, not sale multipliers or current shop prices. Apple 4 + carrot 2 + bread 4 satisfy the low-price recipe. Unknown prices do not fill a band.
guide.ftboss.bonds.series_echo.title: Series Echo
guide.ftboss.bonds.series_echo.requireme: Install at least three distinct foods from one mod namespace in the same weapon’s food accessory sockets; apple + carrot + bread all belong to minecraft.
guide.ftboss.bonds.series_echo.effect: An eligible hit queues 2 additional damage after 0.6 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
guide.ftboss.bonds.series_echo.note: Series means the namespace before the colon in the item ID, not the meat/fish food category. Copies of one food do not count as three distinct foods.
guide.ftboss.bonds.color_repel.title: Color Repel
guide.ftboss.bonds.color_repel.requireme: Install at least one catalog-tagged red, green and gold food in one weapon. Example: apple (red) + melon slice (green) + carrot (gold).
guide.ftboss.bonds.color_repel.effect: An eligible hit repels up to four enemies within 3 blocks of the player. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
guide.ftboss.bonds.color_repel.note: Uses explicit catalog color tags, not the apparent texture color. Untagged foods cannot fill a missing color.
guide.ftboss.bonds.process_burst.title: Process Burst
guide.ftboss.bonds.process_burst.require: In one weapon, install at least one food for each processing tag: RAW, SIMPLE and COMPLEX. Example: raw beef + cooked beef + pumpkin pie.
guide.ftboss.bonds.process_burst.effect: Three consecutive eligible hits, no more than 5 seconds apart, deal 4 splash damage to up to four other enemies near the hit target. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
guide.ftboss.bonds.process_burst.note: Processing stages come from catalog tags, not crafting-grid size. Duplicating one item cannot fill another stage.
spell.ftboss.faded_void_spiral.effect: 24 golden halos rotate around the caster. Contracting ivory rings warn of radiant lances that slow enemies.
spell.ftboss.void_fountain_cascade.effec: Marks the aimed location and three rings of 5, 8 and 12 holy fountains. Telegraphs erupt into golden-white columns that slow enemies.
spell.ftboss.faded_void_spiral.guide: Zicai's holy spell. Golden halos rotate before radiant lances rise. Defeat Zicai for the scroll, or craft it and inscribe it into a spellbook.
spell.ftboss.void_fountain_cascade.guide: Zicai's holy spell. Three rings telegraph successive holy fountains. Defeat Zicai for the scroll, or craft it and inscribe it into a spellbook.
